title: For those who don’t know (how) to ask: Building a dataset of technology questions for digital newcomers
reasoning: The paper uses a quote from the Pesach Haggadah as a rhetorical device to illustrate the challenge of formulating questions when one lacks context. However, the research focus is entirely on digital literacy and the development of LLM-based tutoring datasets, not on evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical topics.
